name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that runs after every major design change. This keeps contrast violations visible in real time without slowing down the workflow. The trade-off is small: it adds a brief delay after each change, but catches errors early when fixes are cheapest.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A live checker trains us to ignore warnings like a car’s seatbelt alarm—we’ll mute it. Better: a pre-submission gate that blocks the build until contrast passes, making the hurdle unavoidable and the cost of ignoring it clear. Settle it with a week-long trial: measure how often we bypass the gate versus how many errors reach production.
